items.response: REDUCE TO IDLE AS OBSTACLES ARE CLEARED
CHECK BOTH (START IF PROPELLER IS STOPPED)
OFF (IF FUEL FLOW DROPS TO ZERO RETURN TO ON)
105 KIAS (INCREASE WITHIN AIRSPEED LIMITATIONS UNTIL FIRE EXTINGUISHED)
CHECK FOR FAULTY CIRCUIT/DO NOT RESET
IF EXCESSIVE VIBRATION, REDUCE TO 2200 RPM AND THEN RAPIDLY INCREASE TO FULL. CYCLE AS NEEDED.

items.text: Watch for induction air filter icing
items.response: 15 INCHES HG IN MP CAN OCCUR ABOVE 8000 FEET
USE 10-20° FLAPS FOR ICE ACCUMULATIONS OF 1 INCH OR LESS. FOR GREATER ICE ACCUMULATION, LAND WITH FLAPS RETRACTED TO ENSURE ADEQUATE ELEVATOR EFFECTIVENESS.
IF MISSED APPROACH IS MANDATORY, APPLY MAXIMAL POWER AND MAINTAIN 100 KIAS WHILE RETRACTING FLAPS IN 10° INCREMENTS.
SELECT OPPOSITE TANK IF SYMPTOMS CONTINUE
OFF AFTER FUEL FLOW HAS STABILIZED
